name: Hel's Kitchen 2.0 (Thor Justice)
description_md:
Thanks to Scion0110 for feedback on this deck!

DECK NOTES

A key to this deck is using [Mjolnir](/card/06009) as a resource. Unlike Steve Rogers, [Odinson](/card/06001b)'s ability is an Action rather than Setup, meaning you can and should be drawing and spending Mjolnir as many turns as possible (even every turn). This essentially allows Thor's hand size to be +1 most turns.

For example, a great first two turns might look like this:

Turn 1: Draw a resource card (like [Genius](/card/01089)), a 4-cost ally ([Nick Fury](/card/01084), [Daredevil](/card/01058), or [Lady Sif](/card/06002)), and [God of Thunder](/card/06008). Summon Mjolnir. Spend the resource card to play God of Thunder. Switch to [Thor](/card/06001a). Use God of Thunder, Mjolnir, and the other two cards in hand to play the 4-cost ally. Thwart with Thor and the ally (if facing [Breakin' & Takin'](/card/01107) or [The "Immortal" Klaw](/card/01127)).

Turn 2: Attack with Thor, use God of Thunder and a card to play a 2-cost card like [Under Surveillance](/card/06031). Switch to Odinson. Summon Mjolnir. Use Mjolnir and the other card to play another 2-cost card.

On the following turn, summon Mjolnir again and it's your choice whether to spend it as a resource or play it to boost your attack and allow for [Hammer Throw](/card/06005).

Just remember, playing [Hammer Throw](/card/06005) later in the game, you can go on another spree of switching back and forth between hero and alter ego using Mjolnir as a resource until you want or need to play it again.

This use of Mjolnir as a resource allows you to have the hand size to focus on taking care of early issues (like a bad side scheme). It's still very helpful to get out [Asgard](/card/06007) or [Avengers Mansion](/card/01091) (you don't necessarily need both), but lean into the Mjolnir-as-resource until you have one of those out later on. Prioritize mulliganing into a strong opening hand to deal with early threats (like a 4-cost ally or [Jessica Jones](/card/01059)) rather than searching for Asgard.

Use [For Asgard!](/card/06004) to trigger [Concussive Blow](/card/05031). Use [Thor's Helmet](/card/06010) or [Lightning Strike](/card/06006) to trigger [For Justice!](/card/01060).

You can wait for just the right moment to play the 1-cost Support/Upgrade cards ([Down Time](/card/05033), [Endurance](/card/05023), [Interrogation Room](/card/01063)).

Remember this cardinal rule: END EVERY TURN WITH AN EMPTY HAND.

The deck rewards clever, intelligent use of Mjolnir as a resource. If you play it right, I think you will really enjoy this dynamic.

Have fun in Hel's Kitchen!
